Team —

We need to begin formal procurement for the upcoming renewals across our developer tooling stack (GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian products). Goal: evaluate a consolidated renewal strategy (single-supplier discounts vs best-of-breed renewals) and produce an RFI to send to vendors and one preferred procurement partner.

Key constraints / asks:
- Timeline: target RFI out by 2027-06-03, vendor responses by 2027-06-17, decision window mid-July.
- Budget: procurement expects rough upper bound for FY28 tooling line (I pulled current spend into the attached CSV).
- Tech requirements: SAML/SCIM support, audit log retention 365+ days, SSO integrations (Okta), on-prem deployment options for Atlassian if needed.
- Commercial asks: enterprise discount schedule, seat-based tiers, marketplace/commit credit structures, early-payment incentives.

Attachments: current-inventory.csv, license-usage-Apr2027.pdf, consolidation-onepager.docx, rfi-template.xlsx

Please:
1) Confirm who will own the RFI (draft + vendor dispatch).
2) Add any must-have technical or procurement questions to the RFI template in Drive (link below).
3) Tell me if you want Optima Consulting looped in for vendor negotiations — they have supported us in the past for similar consolidations.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-tooling-renewals

I'll host a short sync tomorrow 10:00am PT — 20 minutes — unless someone objects.

Thanks,

I pulled seat counts from internal inventory and cross-checked with SSO provisioning. High-level engineering asks to include in RFI: 
- Exact breakout of seat SKUs vs feature SKUs for JetBrains (Commercial vs All Products Pack) — we have mixed usage and will want per-product allocation options.

Agree with a staged approach. A couple of procurement tactics to consider: 
- Negotiate committed spend for GitHub to get a marketplace credit and push JetBrains to match via cross-product discount.
- Ask vendors for a 90-day pilot/extension option if seat counts are disputed — we used that with Atlassian last time and it saved ~12% over an emergency add-on.
- Explore bundling support SLAs rather than premium support seats to reduce unit cost.

If Optima can provide a bid comparison template and run vendor negotiations, that will speed things up. I can be available for vendor calls mid next week.
